designation: Heritage Tree (Heritage Trees Scheme, gazetted by NParks: mature trees of girth over 5 metres and historical, social, cultural, aesthetic, botanical or educational value; each gets lightning protection and English signage)
scope: Complete national Heritage Trees dataset, 255 gazetted trees across Singapore (mainland and offshore islands, including Pulau Ubin). This is the semantic-filtered heritage subset, not the full Trees.sg island-wide inventory, which fails our semantic filter.
caveat: No age, girth, height or vitality field in the dataset: NParks records the heritage designation and a short common-name-plus-location description only. A per-tree girth figure (all heritage trees exceed 5m by definition of the scheme) and any age must come from the NParks page linked in nparks_url or other sources, never invented here. Two Chek Jawa Mangrove Apples are registered a few metres apart as separate trees (left/right of House No. 1); check on the ground or via imagery whether a city pass should treat them as a register twin or as two distinct collectible points before publishing both. location_text is NParks own free-text description, not a street address; several trees are on Pulau Ubin, an island reached by bare-boat ferry from Changi Point, which is well outside the 30-minute day-trip boundary and should not be presented as within Singapore city unless the transport time is stated honestly.
